Make sail: [[SailUp]] sets more canvas, [[SailDown]] takes it in. She goes nowhere furled.
The blue arrow on the rose is the wind; the red wedge is where she cannot sail. Sail across the wind or with it, never into it.
In irons: the sails cannot fill this close to the wind. Turn away with [[Port]] or [[Starboard]] until they draw.
To go upwind, zigzag: sail close-hauled, then turn through the wind with speed on, and settle on the other side.
[[Dock]] docks inside a harbour ring. Buy what is cheap here and sell it where it is wanted.
Prices move as you buy and sell, and drift back over days. The chart ([[Chart]]) remembers what you saw.
A hostile sail. Hold [[FirePort]] or [[FireStarboard]] to aim a broadside and release to fire; ram with speed on if you must.
Water in the hold: [[Order3]] sends hands to the pumps and carpenters to the leaks; [[Order4]] goes back to balanced. A shipwright mends the rest.
Night: your lantern is lit, so you see farther but are seen from afar. [[Lantern]] douses it to slip past unseen.
The bar at the top is the Threat. The sea grows crueller by the day, whatever you do.
